title: Turkish-Style Vegetable Bake
description: A flavorful and healthy vegetable bake infused with the aroma of Turkish spices. Perfect for a weeknight dinner!

ingredients.name: Mixed vegetables
ingredients.notes: such as zucchini, bell peppers, and onions

instructions: In a large bowl, toss the mixed vegetables with 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil, Turkish spice blend, and garlic until coated.
Transfer the vegetables to a baking dish and top with crispy breadcrumbs.
In a separate bowl, mix together herbal salt and 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil.
Brush the mixture evenly over the vegetables.
Bake for 20-25 minutes or until the vegetables are tender and the breadcrumbs are golden brown.
Meanwhile, bake the eggplant in the oven for 10-12 minutes or until tender.
Once the vegetables are done, top with diced eggplant and return to the oven for an additional 2-3 minutes.
